scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend install --include=dev --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix backend run build && node scripts/copy-client.mjs
scripts.start: cd backend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps --omit=dev 2>/dev/null; cd .. && node backend/dist/main.js
